items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Malcolm X used to stick his head in the door, but he didn’t come in there.

ctx.x: This is Smalls you’re talking about?

No, this is Minton’s. Malcolm X used to stick his head in the door, but he didn’t come in there. The big gangsters, Bumpy Johnson, all those people, they used to come in. Another guy named Red Dillon. He was... Phew! Dangerous man. But he used to come in there. See, they had a cook in there named Adele, and everybody loved her cooking.
